paraphrase: At the Huatai assembly Shenhui charged that Shenxiu's line was collateral, not the direct line — Bodhidharma's robe was with Huineng — and that its teaching was gradual: 'freezing the mind to enter samādhi, fixing the mind to view purity, activating the mind to illumine the external, concentrating the mind to realise internally'.
speaker: Shenhui
notes: Shenhui's description of Northern practice is an opponent's report. From memory; no local text.
